briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI competition as compute bottlenecks emerge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. US entities maintain lead but Chinese open-source efforts close gap rapidly. Global AI investment hits record quarterly levels amid infrastructure strain.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with multimodal reasoning gains. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI Colossus cluster reaches 300k H100s. DeepSeek-V3.5 sets new efficiency benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New multi-agent attacks reported in autonomous vehicles. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 1.6nm production for AI chips. Microsoft announces $15B data center expansion in Texas. NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into Q3. Amazon and Google sign long-term power purchase agreements for nuclear restarts.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models surpass closed frontier performance by end of 2027?
